summary: Zentek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the filing of a provisional patent application for ZEN-EMI-01, an EMI shielding coating made from Albany graphite. The company announced preliminary lab results showing the coating absorbs electromagnetic energy rather than reflecting it. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The filing is a routine business development update from a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary product/technology announcement.
